Before we start

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Answers before we get started.

Ask a question →
Can I hire you for design only?

Yes. UI/UX design can be a separate project with files prepared for your developers. We can also include development in the same proposal.

Will you follow our existing brand?

Yes. We work from your approved logo and brand guidelines. Creating or changing the brand identity is separate work and needs to be included in the proposal.

Is user research included?

Planning includes a discussion of your audience and can include a review of the current site. Interviews, usability sessions or wider research are included only when specified in the proposal.
